# python corpus

Real-world Python the language is held to besides the parser's own test suite: every file here is read by the conformance rails, which hold its tree to CPython's `ast.dump`, its tokens to spell the file, and its rows to be the same on every run. The files are copies of public projects, never of this repository.

## Source

Real Python from three public projects, copied unchanged: FastAPI (github.com/fastapi/fastapi, MIT), Requests (github.com/psf/requests, Apache License 2.0) and CPython's standard library (github.com/python/cpython, Python Software Foundation License Version 2). Each file is named by its project and its path in the project, `/` written `_`; each project's licence is beside it, as `NOTICE-<project>-LICENSE`.

## Version

FastAPI at tag `0.115.0`, Requests at tag `v2.32.3` and CPython at tag `v3.14.0`; `NOTICE` lists each file with its project.
